rings.name: Escape the rings
rings.summary: A ball bounces inside 22 spinning rings. Each ring has a gap, and the ring breaks once the ball gets through it.

hexagon.name: Spinning hexagon
hexagon.short: The hexagon test, with a gap
hexagon.summary: The spinning hexagon test with a gap in one wall. The spin speeds up with every bounce.

galton.name: Galton board
galton.summary: 300 balls fall through 12 rows of pegs. Each bin has its own note, so you hear the bell curve fill in.

grow.name: Growing ball
grow.summary: The ball gets a little bigger on every bounce until it fills the circle.

multiply.name: Every bounce adds a ball
multiply.summary: Every bounce can add another ball, up to 200 of them, while a slowly widening gap lets them out.

shrink.name: Shrinking ring
shrink.summary: The ring gets 1.5% smaller every time it is hit, until the ball no longer fits.

strings.name: 100 strings
strings.summary: Each hit ties a string to the ring and speeds the ball up. The ring has to hold 100 of them.

colorwar.name: Color war
colorwar.summary: Two balls paint the ring in their own colour. Whoever owns more of it after 30 seconds wins.

race.name: Ball race
race.summary: Four balls, one small spinning exit. First one out wins.
